<!doctype html>
<style>
  canvas {
    width: 480px;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
  }
</style>
<canvas></canvas>
<script>
// ---- renderer.js
const VW = 160, VH = 192;

const PAL = {
  black: 'rgb(0,0,0)',
  dgray: 'rgb(68,68,68)',
  white: 'rgb(238,238,238)',
  yellow: 'hsl(55,60%,74%)',
  red: 'hsl(343,70%,54%)',
  green: 'hsl(127,70%,54%)',
  lgreen: 'hsl(127,60%,74%)',
};

const FONT = {
  'S': ['111', '100', '111', '001', '111'],
  'C': ['111', '100', '100', '100', '111'],
  'O': ['111', '101', '101', '101', '111'],
  'R': ['110', '101', '110', '101', '101'],
  'E': ['111', '100', '111', '100', '111'],
  'X': ['101', '101', '010', '101', '101'],
  ' ': ['000', '000', '000', '000', '000'],
  '0': ['111', '101', '101', '101', '111'],
  '1': ['010', '110', '010', '010', '111'],
  '2': ['111', '001', '111', '100', '111'],
  '3': ['111', '001', '111', '001', '111'],
  '4': ['101', '101', '111', '001', '001'],
  '5': ['111', '100', '111', '001', '111'],
  '6': ['111', '100', '111', '101', '111'],
  '7': ['111', '001', '001', '001', '001'],
  '8': ['111', '101', '111', '101', '111'],
  '9': ['111', '101', '111', '001', '111'],
};

class Renderer {
  constructor(canvas) {
    canvas.width = VW;
    canvas.height = VH;
    this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  }

  rect(x, y, w, h, color) {
    this.ctx.fillStyle = color;
    this.ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  }

  clear(color) {
    this.rect(0, 0, VW, VH, color);
  }

  text(str, x, y, color) {
    for (const ch of str) {
      const g = FONT[ch];
      for (let r = 0; r < 5; r++)
        for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++)
          if (g[r][c] === '1')
            this.rect(x + c, y + r, 1, 1, color);
      x += 4;
    }
  }
}

// ---- input.js
const BTN = {
  UP: 1, DOWN: 2, LEFT: 4, RIGHT: 8,
};

const KEYS = {
  ArrowUp: BTN.UP, ArrowDown: BTN.DOWN,
  ArrowLeft: BTN.LEFT, ArrowRight: BTN.RIGHT,
};

let held = 0;

addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  held |= KEYS[e.code] ?? 0;
});

addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  held &= ~(KEYS[e.code] ?? 0);
});

const poll = () => held;

// ---- snake.js
const CELL = 10, COLS = 16, ROWS = 17;
const HUD = 16;

class Snake {
  constructor() {
    this.body = [
      { x: 8, y: 8 },
      { x: 7, y: 8 },
      { x: 6, y: 8 },
    ];
    this.dir = { x: 1, y: 0 };
    this.nextDir = this.dir;
    this.tick = 0;
    this.interval = 8;
    this.eaten = 0;
    this.score = 0;
    this.over = false;
    this.spawnFood();
  }

  isFree(x, y) {
    if (x < 0 || x >= COLS) return false;
    if (y < 0 || y >= ROWS) return false;
    return !this.body.some(
      b => b.x === x && b.y === y);
  }

  spawnFood() {
    const free = [];
    for (let y = 0; y < ROWS; y++)
      for (let x = 0; x < COLS; x++)
        if (this.isFree(x, y)) free.push({ x, y });
    const n = Math.random() * free.length;
    this.food = free[Math.floor(n)];
  }

  update(mask) {
    if (this.over) return;
    if (mask & BTN.UP && this.dir.y !== 1)
      this.nextDir = { x: 0, y: -1 };
    else if (mask & BTN.DOWN && this.dir.y !== -1)
      this.nextDir = { x: 0, y: 1 };
    else if (mask & BTN.LEFT && this.dir.x !== 1)
      this.nextDir = { x: -1, y: 0 };
    else if (mask & BTN.RIGHT && this.dir.x !== -1)
      this.nextDir = { x: 1, y: 0 };

    this.tick++;
    if (this.tick % this.interval !== 0) return;

    this.dir = this.nextDir;
    const head = {
      x: this.body[0].x + this.dir.x,
      y: this.body[0].y + this.dir.y,
    };
    const eating = head.x === this.food.x
      && head.y === this.food.y;
    const tail = this.body[this.body.length - 1];
    const hitsTail = !eating &&
      head.x === tail.x && head.y === tail.y;
    if (!hitsTail && !this.isFree(head.x, head.y)) {
      this.over = true;
      return;
    }
    this.body.unshift(head);
    if (eating) {
      this.eaten++;
      this.score += 10 + (8 - this.interval) * 5;
      this.interval = Math.max(3,
        8 - Math.floor(this.eaten / 4));
      this.spawnFood();
      if (!this.food) this.over = true;
    } else {
      this.body.pop();
    }
  }

  render(r) {
    r.clear(PAL.black);
    const f = this.food;
    if (f) r.rect(
      f.x * CELL + 1, HUD + f.y * CELL + 1,
      CELL - 2, CELL - 2, PAL.red);
    r.rect(0, 0, 160, HUD, PAL.dgray);
    const pts = String(this.score).padStart(5, '0');
    r.text('SCORE ' + pts, 4, 5, PAL.white);
    r.text('X' + this.eaten, 132, 5, PAL.yellow);
    this.body.forEach((b, i) => r.rect(
      b.x * CELL, HUD + b.y * CELL, CELL, CELL,
      i === 0 ? PAL.lgreen : PAL.green));
  }
}

// ---- main.js
const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas');
const r = new Renderer(canvas);
const game = new Snake();

const TICK_MS = 1000 / 30;
let last = performance.now(), acc = 0;

function frame(now) {
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  acc += Math.min(now - last, 250);
  last = now;
  while (acc >= TICK_MS) {
    game.update(poll());
    acc -= TICK_MS;
  }
  game.render(r);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
